derivation.recipient_key: (sk, pk) = DeriveKeyPair(SHA-256("edicta/v0 test recipient|" + name)), RFC 9180 section 7.1.3
derivation.ephemeral_key: skE = DeriveKeyPair(SHA-256("edicta/v0 test ephemeral|" + case_id + "|" + index)).sk; index is the 0-based recipient position
derivation.note: Production draws all of these from a CSPRNG. Reject vectors built from a valid case reuse that case's salt, DEK and nonce; their ephemeral keys use their own id.

reject.description: 17 correctly wrapped entries; the limit is 16, checked at the array head.
Two entries, both labelled gate-paper-1; the second wraps the DEK for the auditor key.
Blob version is the text string "0".
Last byte of the blob removed.
One zero byte after the top-level map.
Recipient entry with keys 1 and 2 only.
ciphertext of 48 bytes (salt and tag with an empty plaintext); the minimum is 49.
Entry gate-paper-1 opened with the auditor-1 private key.
No kid given; the only entry does not unwrap under the auditor-1 key.
The auditor-1 kid is not in a blob sealed for gate-paper-1 only.
Two-recipient blob with the two kids swapped; the HPKE aad binds the kid.
Two-recipient blob with the two enc values swapped.
enc is the X25519 point u = 0; the shared secret would be all zero.
Last ciphertext byte (inside the Poly1305 tag) flipped.
HPKE info is the bare ASCII edicta/v0/payload-dek, without the length byte.
HPKE info is tag(edicta/v0/payload), the AEAD tag.
HPKE aad is the kid without its length byte.
Payload AEAD aad is the bare ASCII edicta/v0/payload, without the length byte.
Payload AEAD aad is tag(edicta/v0/receipt): same length, another tag.
Payload AEAD aad is tag(edicta/v0/payload-dek), the HPKE tag.
The commitment carries SHA-256(plaintext) without the salt.
The commitment carries SHA-256(salt' || plaintext) with another salt.
Payload keys in the order 5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6; the hash matches the bytes.
One zero byte after the payload map.
Upper-case media_type; v0 requires lower case.
metadata with an empty data byte string.
The commitment's action has qty 10000 (statically valid: notional 572.50 <= max_notional 1200.00); the payload has 20000.
The commitment's max_notional is one unit higher.

One ciphertext that ChaCha20-Poly1305 accepts under two DEKs. gate-paper-1 unwraps DEK1 and opens the committed payload; auditor-1 unwraps DEK2, the AEAD check passes, and the bytes differ. Only the plaintext_hash comparison, made before parsing, rejects them.
